name: FileRelay (in-tab loopback)
description: Browser build of the FileRelay courier transport: an in-memory loopback queue running as WebAssembly inside the tab. Messages only; it does not contact a FileRelay router or shard and has no file transfer (WASM ABI v1 has neither network nor transfer ops); use the native filerelay package for the real relay. No keys, opaque frames only.
